summary: Make front-door certification reject supposedly open early footholds whose threshold still depends on parental deposits, guarantees, inherited housing position, or comparable family backing.
revision_focus: teach `START_HERE.md` and `docs/20-program/ideal-distribution-and-policy-portfolio.md` to say plainly that lower-half footholds do not count fully when ordinary early entry still depends on parental deposits, guarantees, inherited housing position, or comparable family backing at the threshold moment
extend the ideal-order pass bundle plus compact blocker and verdict speech so sub-certification statuses can now be tagged as **family-gated** where that is the live breach
extend `docs/00-meta/release-readiness-and-bundle-integrity-checks.md` so future front-door certification summaries keep that anti-family-threshold qualifier explicit
sync the release shell, changelog, version, revision-memory scope, receipt, and manifests to the new bundle
why_now: the archive already says late inheritance and parental housing position are not substitutes for open early circulation, but the shortest answer still left an early-entry loophole where family money could silently do the threshold work

lifting parental deposits, guarantees, inherited housing position, and comparable family backing into the front door makes certification stricter about footholds that arrive on time only for entrants with dynastic help at the gate
this sharpens the archive's answer to ideal distribution and certification without widening the target family or adding a new doctrine branch
